state: This draft awards monetary commitments with atomic remaining-budget checks, without disbursing funds. Reviews belong to an assigned non-applicant account which must currently hold reviewer role and workplace access. Once intake is submitted its assignee and content are locked. An assignee may lose role or workplace access after the deadline; applicant-linked correction is ordinarily permitted only before close. Location-scoped coordinator must restore review without changing amount, account, answer/question snapshot, frozen program criteria/terms, actual receipt/evidence/override, or earlier decision evidence. Existing Can permits typed copy, create/set, conditional lock predicates evaluated on the old row, automatic audit, immutable evidence children, and linked correction records; it supplies no privileged lock override. Both designs below require submitted undecided state, present loss of old reviewer eligibility, valid distinct replacement, scoped coordinator and nonblank attributable reason in an atomic ordinary transaction. Neither revises intake/deadline, commits budget or declares money paid. Both retain privacy for applicant/scoped coordinator/current eligible assigned reviewer, freeze terms/criteria via ordinary fields, strengthen assignment/submission actual role checks, and reject stale or repeated unsupported recovery. Original rejected decisions are never changed. This is a desired source/JavaScript contract, not implemented infrastructure.

recovery.instructions: Which representation best meets this same recovery contract with low authoring and maintenance complexity?

criteria.assignment: Add a reasoned immutable assignment-evidence child to the existing Application, storing old/new account, acting coordinator and timestamp. Permit writing only its reviewer field when the old reviewer presently fails role or workplace eligibility by narrowing that field lock predicate on pre-state. A scoped submitted-only recovery action requires a valid non-self successor. Keep all other locked intake and decision fields intact. This preserves one intake identity and existing budget/receipt projections but requires a dynamic reviewer lock and new evidence child.
criteria.revision: Reuse linked revision form: recovery creates an immutable submitted successor with copied account, monetary request, snapshot content and original receipt; reviewer changes only in the new record. Preserve coordinator/reason/time evidence and supersede the pending original atomically. Submitted assignee lock stays absolute. This preserves original record identity as history but introduces copied content, more revisions in applicant presentation and guards coordinating pending correction drafts with recovery.
